hero.titleLine1: A resume that gets past the bots.
hero.subtitle: LocalATSCV helps you build a resume optimized for applicant tracking systems (ATS) and tailor it to every job in a few clicks. Everything happens in your browser: no account, no data sent anywhere.

ats.title: Your resume is read by a machine first
ats.text: Most large companies and recruiting agencies sort applications with an ATS (Applicant Tracking System). It extracts the text of your resume, stores it in a database and lets recruiters search candidates by keyword.

layout.title: Complex layouts
layout.text: Columns, tables and text boxes scramble the reading order: your information comes out jumbled.

image.title: Unreadable text
image.text: Icons, skill gauges and some design-tool exports turn into gibberish characters, or no text at all.

keywords.title: Missing keywords
keywords.text: If the job ad's vocabulary doesn't appear in your resume, your profile won't show up in recruiters' searches.

ats.fix: LocalATSCV does the opposite: a single column, real text and standard section headings that bots read in the right order.

how.title: Write it once, tailor it endlessly
how.text: Four steps turn your Master resume into a tailored application for every job.

profile.title: Fill in your Master resume
profile.text: Enter all your experience once and for all, or import your LinkedIn profile PDF to save time.

offer.title: Paste the job ad
offer.text: LocalATSCV extracts its keywords and computes a match score out of 100, updated as you type.

compose.title: Build a tailored version
compose.text: Tick the relevant experiences and bullet points, reorder them with drag and drop. Nothing is deleted from your Master.

export.title: Export to PDF
export.text: A text-based, structured, single-column PDF that reads as well for bots as it does for recruiters.

privacy.title: Zero data on our servers. Literally.
privacy.text: There is no database to hack: our server only sends you the application. After that, everything happens in your browser, even offline.

browser.title: Your browser
browser.note: Stored in IndexedDB, on this device only.

server.title: localatscv.mbonnici.fr
server.text: Serves the application files (HTML, CSS, JavaScript), nothing more.

account.title: No account
account.text: No sign-up, no email, no password. Open the page and get started.

trackers.title: No trackers
trackers.text: No analytics, no ads, no cookies. Even the fonts are self-hosted.

csp.title: Technically locked down
csp.text: The site's security policy (CSP) forbids the browser from contacting any other domain. The code is open source: check it yourself.

backup.title: Your backups, your files
backup.text: Export all your data to a JSON file and import it back on any device.

features.title: Everything you need to land the interview

master.title: Master resume and tailored versions
master.text: One complete resume, as many variants as applications. Tick, untick: nothing is ever lost.

score.title: Match score
score.text: Paste the job ad: matched keywords, missing keywords and a score out of 100 in real time.

weak.title: Weak phrase detector
weak.text: “Responsible for”, “helped with”… are flagged automatically, with a bank of action verbs to replace them.

analyzer.title: Existing resume analyzer
analyzer.text: Drop in a resume made elsewhere: see what the bot actually reads and what to fix.

linkedin.title: LinkedIn import
linkedin.text: Pre-fill your Master resume from the free PDF you can export from your LinkedIn profile.

languages.title: 5 resume languages
languages.text: French, English, Italian, Spanish and German. In English, photo and date of birth are hidden, following English-speaking norms.

pdf.title: ATS-friendly PDF export
pdf.text: Real text and a clear structure: readable by bots, pleasant for recruiters.

offline.title: Installable and offline
offline.text: Add LocalATSCV to your home screen and keep working without a connection.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.text: Question not listed here? Write to us:

ats.a: An Applicant Tracking System is the software recruiters use to receive, sort and search applications. It converts your resume to text and indexes it: if the text is badly extracted or the right keywords are missing, your application becomes hard to find.

storage.a: Only in your browser, using IndexedDB, a database built into every modern browser. It never goes through our servers, which only know how to serve the application files.

clear.q: What happens if I clear my browser data?
clear.a: Your resumes are erased, since they exist nowhere else. Export a JSON backup regularly: you can import it back at any time, on any device.

score.q: Does the score guarantee my resume will be shortlisted?
score.a: No. Every ATS has its own rules and the final decision is made by a human. The score is an indicator: it checks that your resume uses the job ad's vocabulary and that a machine can read it correctly.

photo.q: Why does the photo disappear in English?
photo.a: In the UK, the US and many English-speaking countries, photos and dates of birth are discouraged to limit hiring discrimination. Some recruiters even reject resumes that include them.

free.a: Yes. LocalATSCV is an open source project under the MIT license, with no ads or subscription. It costs almost nothing to host, since your browser does all the work.
